why: Build round 3 for anti-slop judgment slice AS-no-unknown-parameters-1, in next/, from head 8ba6ddba6, which already merges origin/main with pull request 1366 in it. The rule anti-slop/no-unknown-parameters was forced to error in a scratch config outside the repo and run over next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime, cloudflare, processes and tezgah. At 8ba6ddba6 it met 225 hits: 43 in exam paths and 182 in product files. The build fixed 21 product hits by hand edits (no quick fix exists for this rule), each typed from where the value already lives, all in the runtime files pull request 1366 brought in. runtime/Runner.ts, 12 hits: the Cmd helpers operands, decodeStartChild, decodeExit, decodeStopChild, decodeHands, decodeMonitor, decodeDemonitor, withoutInput, withoutItems and oversized now take Schema.Json, since every caller passes Dispatched.cmd, which the schema holds as Schema.Json. bytes takes Schema.Json or undefined, since it measures a Cmd or a start_child's optional Json input. checkpoint's turn takes the Turn schema's type or null, the only two values its callers pass. A small isJsonObject guard replaces two `as Record<string, unknown>` casts. runtime/RecoveryStore.ts, 6 hits: textIn, generationIn, receiptFor and decode take the SqlValue (or undefined) that a Sql row column holds, and the catch handler failed names its thrown value cause, which is the rule's own exempt name. runtime/ProcessStore.ts, 2 hits: storage.put takes the Activity marker, the only value it is ever given, and failed names its value cause. runtime/QuotaRunner.ts, 1 hit: reserveFault walks a cause chain, so its parameter is named cause. A recount after the edits found 204 hits: 43 exam and 161 product. Three hits the tests step expected the build to type stay as written, because each is a door that decodes with a Schema first (0563's first kind). runtime/Runner.ts:484 ProgramRunner.msg decodes its input with the runner's Delivery schema, whose envelope id is looser than Incoming's. Its caller, cloudflare/runtime.ts:2451 ProcessService.msg, takes the value off an RPC between objects as unknown, so typing it Incoming would claim a shape that nothing checks before the runner's own decode. cloudflare/runtime.ts:2021 codeInstall and :2022 codeFailed are reached by name from the control socket (control.ts:50 and 51, dev.ts:572 and 577 send JSON), and they decode with Install and the code.failed fields. So the exam fakes at runtime/StartChildTest.ts:472 and cloudflare/reload.laws.test.ts:209 and 211 stay too. RecoveryStore save (:67, :238) was typed S and then taken back: the RecoveryStore service is Store<Kept>, while callers save the whole journal of their own schema, and tsc refused runtime/RunnerSupervision.integration.test.ts:534. So the store checks a value it cannot type, which makes it a door. next/packages/libfabrika/src/Testing.ts:13 Options.equals was not changed. Testing.ts:53 calls it on models, possibly undefined, and :57 calls it on Cmd lists, so the honest type is S, or a list of C, or undefined. That still would not let supervisor.laws.test.ts:64 canon take Model. Only splitting equals in two would, which is an API change to every syncTest caller, outside this slice's folders. It is listed and not fixed. Left, 161 product hits, by kind. (a) Doors that decode with a Schema first: runtime/Runner.ts:484, 2521; runtime/ProcessStore.ts:135, 414 (record decodes a RuntimeRecord); runtime/RecoveryStore.ts:67, 238 (save checks against its caller's schema), 369 (recoveryState); cloudflare/runtime.ts:1453, 1559, 1701, 1807, 1860, 1861, 1902, 1905, 1917, 1943, 1969, 2021, 2022, 2043, 2086, 2105, 2394, 2443, 2451, 2465, 2508, 2509, 2519 (the project and process objects' RPC and control doors); cloudflare/QuotaSettings.ts:40, 65; runtime/Patch.ts:122 (two); and the doors build1 listed in SettingsInput, tail, mail, box, bindings, objects, Process, Mailbox, Built, State, Audit, Execution, Program and Client. (b) A program's own model, Msg, Cmd answer or handler error, which the runtime must not read: runtime/Runner.ts:1554 (two), 1637, 1645, 2212, 2926, 2928, 2930, 2942; cloudflare/runtime.ts:346, 1215 (the audit message); and build1's Execution, ExecutionCalls, Stepper and box contracts. (c) Typed by ticket 1053's branch fabrikalfa/unknown-params (News and Published), which is not on main: cloudflare/runtime.ts:348, 1203, 2035; cloudflare/Publish.ts:8, 10; cloudflare/connection.ts:236, 310, 328; cloudflare/bindings.ts:281, 331; cloudflare/objects.ts:67. (d) Unclear: runtime/Patch.ts:28, 41, 93 (diff and its helpers). Runner.ts:1358 passes Live.view, which Runner.ts:410 types unknown, and Opened.view is View. Typing it as Json means retyping the view across Program, Execution and the runner, which is a design reach and not a local type. Also cloudflare/platform.ts:357 StorageClient.put, as build1 found. No disable line, no lock line, no .oxlintrc.json change, no exam path touched, no assertion deleted or narrowed, no law loosened.
